1436 is a Hijri year. Converting 06-12-1436 to Gregorian:  
12th month Dhu al-Hijjah 1436 AH corresponds roughly to September 2015.  
06-12-1436 AH = 2015-09-19 Gregorian (using approximate conversion).  
Add 186 days:  
From 2015-09-19, add 11 days → 2015-09-30 (11 days).  
Add 31 days (October) → 2015-10-31 (42 total).  
Add 30 days (November) → 2015-11-30 (72 total).  
Add 31 days (December) → 2015-12-31 (103 total).  
Add 31 days (January 2016) → 2016-01-31 (134 total).  
Add 29 days (February 2016 leap) → 2016-02-29 (163 total).  
Add 23 more days → 2016-03-23 (186 total).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 2016-03-23
